name: Chanjet Information Technology Company Limited
summary: Chanjet Information Technology Company Limited engages in the cloud service and software businesses in the Mainland China and internationally. The company provides platform services, application services, and value-added data-based services for micro and small-scale enterprises. It is also involved in technical development, consulting, transfer, service, and training of computer software, and hardware and external devices; sale of printing paper, computer consumables, computer software, and hardware and external devices; provision of databases and internet information services; and agency bookkeeping services, as well as design, manufacturing, agency, and publication of advertisements.
